name: 🦎Camo Or Snipe! 💥
desc:
LIMITED TIME CODE (x3 SPINS AND 500 CASH): BUGSFIXED

Camo or Snipe is a game similar to hide & seek, but with a twist. Hiders camouflage themselves in their surroundings, while seekers use sniper rifles to track them down and eliminate them!

🦎 Hiders: Blend into the environment to avoid being spotted by the snipers. If a hider is found, they will be eliminated.

🔫 Snipers: Search for hiders who are camouflaged in the surroundings. Look for subtle hints of movement or any mistakes made by the hiders.

Tags: Sniper, FPS, Hide and Seek, Camo, Props

scripts.title: Croxyub Hub  ESP Movement Mobile
scripts.features:
Croxyub Hub – Features

Player Role ESP – See everyone's role (Sniper, Hider, Lobby) with colors and name tags above their head. Toggle on/off.

ESP – Highlights any Players. Optional team colors.

Walk Speed & Jump Power – Sliders to change your speed and jump height. Stays on after you die.

Infinite Jump – Self‑explanatory.

Client Invisible – Makes your character invisible to you.

Client Bring Hiders – Drags Hider‑role players toward you on your screen .

Auto‑Respawn – Your speed, jump, and invisibility reapply when you respawn.

All settings save automatically.
